description: AppLovin Corporation provides end-to-end artificial intelligence-powered advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audience, generating revenue when advertisers achieve their return on advertising spend targets, so that their success directly fuels its growth. Its advertising solutions include Axon Ads Manager, a user acquisition solution offering advanced campaign management, real-time analytics and lifetime value reporting, and MAX, an in-app bidding solution that optimizes the value of publishers' advertising inventory by running a single unbiased, real-time competitive auction. Through its technologies and scaled distribution, advertisers can place content so it is discovered by the right audience and manage, optimize and analyze marketing investments, while publishers can better monetize their gaming apps.
